payload.description: The frozen BA-QM7/QM-J past-only Lag-1 data control produced a 20-session mean-daily-Spearman of 0.028320276156366626 versus 0.028247224219975102 for the current score on the identical matched grid. Under the predeclared 0.01 similarity margin, the negative control is similarly strong and triggers Promotion Stop, Investigation and CAPA. Root cause is not yet established.
payload.title: Phase-1A Selection current score fails Lag-1 negative control

details.scope: Phase-1A Selection 20-session level-score research evidence freshness and incremental information relative to the immediately preceding observed score.
details.triage_rationale: Promotion is blocked by the frozen QM-J rule because a past-only one-observation-lag score is similarly strong to the current score on the same matched grid. The separate pseudo-signal control did not trigger, so the investigation is scoped first to temporal redundancy/freshness of Selection information rather than a general outcome or pipeline bias.

details.cause: On the frozen Phase-1A 20-session level-score estimand, the current Selection score is almost entirely redundant with the immediately preceding observed score: global current-vs-lag Spearman is 0.9966339839043021, median daily Spearman is 0.9964118298432567, median absolute score change is 0.26000000000000156 points, and the median observation gap is one calendar day. The change component itself has no positive incremental 20-session signal in this diagnostic (mean daily Spearman -0.00387338683094239; rank-change -0.0032126670502650163). This temporal persistence explains why the past-only Lag-1 control matched/slightly exceeded the current level score under the frozen QM-J rule.

details.corrective_action: Keep Phase-1A level-score promotion blocked and create a pre-registered research-only incremental-freshness evaluation that separates level information from score/rank change, compares current score against past-only lagged baselines on matched grids, and uses dependence-aware/non-overlapping inference where applicable. No production Selection rule, weight, threshold, Decision Layer behavior, or order path may change from this CAPA plan alone.
details.preventive_action: Require future Selection evidence packages that claim fresh incremental information to include an outcome-blind lagged-information negative control and an explicit incremental-to-lag estimand before confirmation/promotion. Register the hypothesis, analysis plan, multiplicity/dependence treatment and evidence state through the existing QM-A/QM-C/QM-J governance before outcomes are inspected.

details.implementation_summary: Implemented a research-only fail-closed Selection freshness guard that keeps the spent Phase-1A level-score evidence PROMOTION_BLOCKED, binds the guard to the frozen Lag-1 falsification and post-trigger investigation hashes, requires prospective preregistered incremental-freshness evidence before any future release, and leaves scanner weights, Selection/Timing signals, Decision Layer, Depot Watch, orders and execution unchanged.

payload.description: QM-I Portfolio Action ancestry represented 7D Decision and Position Snapshot but did not fully register material W6 Elliott review context and W7/W8 path-state parents that can change the final review action.
payload.title: Material post-7D action parents missing from QM-I lineage

details.scope: Phase-7 Portfolio Action evidence lineage and independence review
details.triage_rationale: The missing parents do not prove a false action, but they can make material evidence ancestry look more independent than it is. Existing actions require evidence review, not automatic invalidation.

details.cause: QM-I Phase-7 action registration predated later W6 and W7/W8 integrations and retained the older parent model after those contexts became capable of changing review actions.

details.corrective_action: Register W6 immediate decision context and W7/W8 source claim as material Portfolio Action parents; fail closed when W8 changes an action without registered state-history ancestry.
details.preventive_action: Regression-test all future post-7D action modifiers for material ancestry and keep incomplete upstream lineage explicitly incomplete rather than inferring independence.

details.implementation_summary: Added typed W6 decision-context ancestry, W7/W8 state-history claim ancestry, and a fail-closed W8 lineage guard without changing Universal Stance, Portfolio Action rules or execution.

details.closure_rationale: The lineage defect is corrected and regression-protected. No empirical promotion had occurred and no false execution was observed.

payload.description: The W8 Ferrari/RACE F1-F4 action policy was introduced on 2026-10-01 after inspection of the source case, while the original Phase-7I validation protocol was frozen on 2026-09-25.
payload.title: Outcome-driven W8 policy introduced after the frozen 7I boundary

details.scope: Post-freeze W8 empirical validation and Decision Layer promotion governance
details.triage_rationale: The W8 rule may remain research-only, but the inspected Ferrari/RACE source case cannot count as independent confirmation and the original frozen 7I contract must not be retroactively rewritten.

details.cause: A later outcome-informed review policy was integrated into the research action path after the original 7I freeze without a separate post-change prospective evidence boundary.

details.corrective_action: Preserve the original 7I freeze unchanged and govern W8 through a separate post-freeze overlay that treats Ferrari/RACE as spent regression evidence and requires prospective-unspent W8 traces from 2026-10-02 onward.
details.preventive_action: Any future outcome-driven post-freeze policy change must receive its own introduction date, spent-evidence cutoff, prospective start and promotion guard without rewriting the original frozen validation identity.

details.implementation_summary: Added a research-only post-freeze W8 governance overlay with spent-source-case treatment, a 2026-10-02 prospective boundary and dynamic W8 shadow-trace promotion gating while restoring the frozen 7I contract unchanged.

details.closure_rationale: The governance defect is corrected and the original 7I freeze is preserved. W8 remains empirically unvalidated.

payload.title: Live Watch runtime has under 20 percent shard transport reserve

details.scope: BA-QM10/BA-QM12 Watch runtime transport and operational headroom
details.triage_rationale: Reserve warning must remain active until a real regenerated 64-shard runtime proves at least 20 percent reserve; preserve baseline snapshot and existing promotion blocks.

details.cause: Uneven 64-bucket hash routing concentrates several complete symbol histories in shard_3f and caused low reserve; CI additionally assumed warning always false.

details.corrective_action: Version deterministic byte-balanced routing of all unchanged symbol histories; keep 64 shards, verify reader/writer and W10 provenance, require real rebuilt runtime at least 20 percent reserve, retain 2MB hard stop.
details.preventive_action: Keep a separate capacity health gate with threshold boundary tests and nonpublishing PR preview; record independently measured headroom with current scanner snapshot.

details.implementation_summary: Branch-only fix: size_balanced_v1 deterministic routing, explicit PASS/REVIEW_REQUIRED/FAIL capacity classification, negative boundary tests and PR real-source preview; actual live publication and independent CAPA effectiveness not yet completed.

details.scope: BA-QM12 numeric scanner score coverage, independent quality monitoring only
details.triage_rationale: Current scanner reports 215/215 numeric scores, but BA-QM12 does not independently enforce the published min_score_ratio; upstream-ok mutation could silently bypass QM monitor.

details.cause: _snapshot_monitor reads numeric_score_count without evaluating published history_metadata.validation.policy.min_score_ratio and without checking malformed counts or policy independently of upstream status.

details.corrective_action: Enforce published scanner score policy with ceil(symbol_count * min_score_ratio), reject absent/invalid policy/count and subthreshold coverage even when upstream status ok; expose observed and minimum coverage.
details.preventive_action: Parameterized mutation tests for invalid and subthreshold metadata, exact-boundary pass, current production snapshot pass, and independent CI effectiveness verification.

details.implementation_summary: Implementation and negative mutation tests on isolated repair branch. CI and main effectiveness are pending. No scoring/Decision/portfolio, history or empirical promotion changes.

details.effectiveness_summary: New independent BA-QM12 check was merged via PR245, tests included upstream-ok but mutated subthreshold score-count and alternative policy, malformed/missing/nonfinite policy and count, exact threshold and actual 215/215 positive production snapshot. Subsequent main BA-QM12 run 37899660077 passed 29 tests and 92 permanent regressions; QM-H main run 37899660064 passed 259 tests. Current published policy min_score_ratio=0.9, ceil(215 * 0.9)=194, observed numeric_score_count=215, PASS. No scanner scoring or research promotion changes.

details.closure_rationale: Independent numeric score coverage gate is now in main and prospectively observed passing with same-snapshot policy, exact count, negative mutation tests and separate QM-H regression. This closes F02 static enforcement gap only; F03/F04 still OPEN and six empirical blocks retain independent fail-closed status.
details.evidence_disposition_reference: EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED resolved for this monitor enforcement gap: current actual scanner metadata is valid (215/215, threshold 0.9), no historic invalid scores observed or inferred, no revision of original audit findings/history or automatic research-promotion eligibility.
